comparison.objective: Fit a stop pin so a swinging arm reaches its work pad but not a walkway; candidate removes installed insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin placement and functional travel constraint versus narrow-tool alignment, bimanual striking, notch fracture, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Arm travel bounded between work and walkway regions versus four fractured and contained tangs without insert or shell damage. Body and specs provide no further rubric.
comparison.reason: The record tests placement that configures mechanism travel, not contact-driven break-off finishing.
